lines.t: Every idle word, rising in the air
Scoffing at the warning, mocking what is fair
tongues like sharpened arrows laughing at your call building up a tower that's destined still to
fall they say where is his promise where is now his hand they trample on the holy
They love the shifting sand
They speak against your counsel
They call the truth a lie
Forgetting every whisper
That nothing escapes your eye
Every eye to word will stand in the fire
Every careless breath will rise ever higher
All the bitter mocking, every hardened sound
Will echo back in judgment
When your voice comes down
Teach my lips to tremble at the things I say
Let my heart speak only, what will not burn away
Some say who can hear him?
Who knows what he has spoken?
They jest at all your mercy
They treat your love as broken
They drag your name through darkness
For gaining far applause
Blind to the coming moment
When you will plead your cause
But you weigh every sentence
Every seed of speech
You hear what the tongue sows
In the hidden reach
For words are like a river
Flowing from the heart
Revealing what is living
And what is grown upon
Every idle word will stand in the fire
Every careless breath will rise ever higher
All the bitter mocking, every hardened sound
Will echo back in judgment when your voice comes down
Wash my lips with coal from the altar flame
Let my mouth bear witness to your holy name
Let no idol whisper, curse the things you've done.
Let no scoffers' laughter drown the voice of your son.
Break the proud defiance, silence every lie.
Call the mocker to repentance before the day is nigh.
Turn our idol chatter into honest prayer.
Turn our empty thunder into truth laid bare
So I lay down my phrases, the careless and untrue
The jokes that pierce my neighbor, the doubts that spoke of you
I turn from every murmur that loved the world's reward
word i choose the narrow language that honors the lord every idle word will stand in the fire
but a humble tongue is all that you desire fill my mouth with mercy let my speech be clean
a witness to your glory and all that's heard and seen on that coming morning when all hearts are
Let me stand forgiven for every idle word Guard the gate of my lips
Keep my spirit stirred Till every breath that leaves me
Is a faithful word
Oh, oh, oh.
